SidebarExpanded.Name: Open sidebar on startup
SidebarExpanded.Hint: Keep the right sidebar expanded when the game loads. If unchecked, it starts collapsed.

DarkChat.Name: Dark chat
DarkChat.Hint: Show the chat as white on black: a frame in the player's color around their messages, whispers in blue, system decorative backgrounds removed. Unchecked: original style.

JoinMusic.Name: Join page music
JoinMusic.Hint: Music looped on the players' join page. The module writes it into the world description: clear this field before disabling the module. No effect with the "minimal" join theme.

JoinMusicVolume.Name: Join page music volume
JoinMusicVolume.Hint: Starting volume of the music on the join page. Each player can then adjust it for themselves with the speaker at the bottom left of the page.

JoinMusic.Error: Liwil QoL: could not save the join page music into the world description.
JoinMusic.Blocked: Liwil QoL: Foundry sandboxed the join page player, the music will not be able to play.

FolderTextColor.Name: Text color
FolderTextColor.Hint: Color of the folder name in lists. Empty: Foundry's original color.
